junro.title: Prioritree CI — the continuous-integration surface: the floor in GitHub Actions (test/lint/typecheck), the CodeQL scanning config owned by the tree, the ruff phase-2 enforcement landed where the hook deferred it — the FREE-TIER law (nothing paid on the platform), the PyPI precondition's named remainder closed; the full junro, all seats participating
inputs: THE COLLABORATOR'S CONVENING (2026-11-23): the CI effort convenes now — only for things that are FREE on GitHub (nothing paid on the platform); the inward-first direction ruled (the auth write-exposure cure and the order-bias probe after CI, outward/PyPI after inward); the >100-item scale fence held (no list in the current mindset — adaptive scheduling stays banked until the real earn)

THE AUTH REFRAME (Q-auth-widening at the birth store, ruled 2026-11-23): auth is the WRITE-EXPOSURE CURE (a reachable server is a writable filesystem), re-ranked to the inward priority class — the API-key infrastructure the design's leading candidate; the inward lane after CI: auth first, the order-bias probe after

the CodeQL event's lesson (FR-MEM-0033): GitHub's scanning already live at the default setup — the tree should own its config rather than inherit it; the first finding triaged false-positive at HEAD, the standing triage form recorded

the PyPI precondition's remainder: the LICENSE cured (MIT), the packaging cured (web + MCP in the wheel) — CI the named remainder; the hook's ruff phase 2 (.githooks/pre-commit: pyright only, ruff 'PHASE 2 (named, pending)') — the enforcement landing where the hook deferred it
the standing laws carried: the seat-authored report (R6/R11), the per-step dispatch (R8, the file-unit), the two-lane form, the ThreePart, the census-first composition
the floor at HEAD: 203 passed, zero findings, zero ignores; the five forms whole

We don't want to pay for anything on that platform.\"): THE CI SURFACE RIDES ONLY THE FREE TIER — nothing paid on the platform: the free runner minutes (the public-repo unlimited form / the free allocation), GitHub's free CodeQL scanning (already live at the default setup per FR-MEM-0033 — the tree owning its config, not buying a service), no paid Actions, no paid services, no runner upgrades.
